text_blocks.snippet: While flu vaccines don't contain fetal cells, some vaccines, including certain flu vaccines, utilize cell cultures that were originally derived from human fetal tissue in their development. These cell lines have been maintained in labs for decades and are used to grow viruses for vaccine production. However, the final vaccine product does not contain any fetal cells or tissue.
